text: {"summary":"Public history: Task is a two-module Python 3.11 repair. Entrypoint `engine.solve(data)`; return complete contents of allowlisted `engine.py` and `rules.py`, no third-party libraries/tools/network/workspace. Candidate artifact currently handles account/currency defaults, amount rules, and refunds, but not event deduplication. Stages 1–2 have public-pass receipts (8 checks); stage 3 requirements are supplied, not yet implemented/verified; stage 4 remains. Current code: `engine.solve` iterates events, calls `amount`, negates refunds, sums under `account|currency` defaults `default|USD`. `rules.amount` computes price×quantity (default 1), clamps discount basis points to [0,10000], rounds discounted net, then applies default-0 tax to that rounded net with independent rounding, adds tax. `_round_div` uses floor division for mode `floor`, otherwise `(n + denominator//2)//denominator` (half-up); stipulated intermediate magnitudes are nonnegative. Requirement 5: aggregate by account and currency, never convert; retain keys whose totals are zero. Requirement 6: deduplicate by event `id`, retaining greatest revision; ties go to last input position. Revisions need not be chronological. Missing IDs are unique `anonymous:<original_position>`. Apply the winning events only. Refund negation applies to final amount after tax. Public source explicitly warns trial notes are unverified; no wrong attempt should be invented. Outstanding: implement deduplication and all stated requirements, then address stage 4 when revealed. Task says a stage pass is provisional."}
